EntraId._comment: Placeholders — not real values. Fill in from the API's Azure App Registration once it exists (docs/architecture/00-analysis.md §18). Until then every request is correctly rejected as unauthenticated.

MicrosoftGraph._comment: Placeholders — not real values. App-only (client credentials) access to search the tenant directory, used to pre-provision users before their first login. Requires the Graph application permission User.Read.All with admin consent and a client secret on the same App Registration as EntraId — see docs/security/entra-id-setup.md. Leave ClientSecret empty (set via user-secrets/Key Vault/env var) to disable this feature safely; the search endpoint then returns a clear 'not configured' error instead of pretending to work. SenderMailbox is optional on top of that: a real mailbox (needs a Microsoft 365 license) to send assignment notification emails from via Graph's sendMail, requiring the additional application permission Mail.Send with admin consent — see docs/security/entra-id-setup.md §1b. Leave it empty to fall back to Smtp:Host if configured, or to no email delivery at all.

Frontend._comment: Placeholder — not a real value. Public base URL of the Next.js frontend, used to build absolute links inside emails (the backend has no other way to know its own frontend's origin). Defaults to http://localhost:3000 if left empty.
